specs.Other Special Features of the Product: 15W Magnetic Wireless Power Bank, 22.5W Max Output, Digital Display, Fast Charging, Type C PD Output

features: Smallest Magnetic Wireless Power Bank : Portronics Luxcell Magclick 10K supports 15W Magsafe (wireless) charging for QI-enabled devices (iPhone- 12 and above, Samsung S series etc).

Luxury Stylish Body: Its ultra-compact body with fine Stylish finish gives it a premium look. Apart from being powerful, it fits effortlessly into your bag or pocket, making it the ideal travel companion.

22.5W Portable Power Bank: This smallest 10,000mAh Lithium Polymer battery power bank delivers a rapid 22.5W maximum output, guaranteeing you'll never run out of battery again. Stay charged on the go!

Dual Port Fast Charge: This fast charging power bank offers you Fast charging via Type C PD Port and USB MACH port, so you can charge multiple devices at one time. Refuel the power bank via the Type C port.

Luxury Charging Solution: Glam up your charging routine with Luxcell Magclick 10K Wireless Power Bank, which combines lasting performance with stunning aesthetics. Get a complementary Type C to Type C cable as a bonus!
Real Time Battery Display : This 10000 mAh Fast charging Power bank has a transparent plastic casing with Battery Display, keeping you informed about the power bank and your device’s charge.

Broad Compatibility: Luxcell Magclick 10K, PD Power Bank is compatible with smartphones, tablets, earbuds, neckbands, speakers, smartwatches, and other USB-powered devices. It can charge an iPhone 14 battery up to 45% in an hour.

BIS Certified: BIS certified with advanced chip protection layers, this Made in India power bank ensures your devices are safeguarded against short circuits, over-temperature, and over-voltage issues.
